text.content:
The resort that never opened.

Region: Night City, the southern coast
Controlled by: The Voodoo Boys in Coastview and West Wind; Kurt Hansen and BARGHEST in Dogtown
Feel: Half-built hotels, abandoned rides, and the best black market on the West Coast
Notable locations: Coastview & West Wind: Batty's Hotel, Eden Beach Mega Ride, Grand Imperial Mall, Hotel Pistis Sophia, Pacifica Serenity Bible Church. Dogtown: Black Sapphire, Eden Plaza, EBM Petrochem Stadium, Heavy Hearts, Terra Cognita
Danger: Combat zone

Pacifica was mansions, coastal estates and the Playland by the Sea theme park. In the late 2050s investors poured billions into turning it into a tourist resort, bringing in hundreds of laborers, mostly from Haiti. The Unification War ended the dream and left the buildings half-finished.

The city cut off services to Coastview and West Wind after the Voodoo Boys resisted its return; the gang runs things there now. Dogtown is Colonel Kurt Hansen's fiefdom, with a black market in the old EBM Petrochem Stadium, where a Zhirafa cargo aerozep came down after BARGHEST shot it out of the sky.

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.19
